company.name: DG AFRIQUE
company.legalSeat: Abobo Dokui, Block 143 Lot 12, Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire

hero.title: The bridge between Africa and the world
hero.subtitle: International trade, raw materials, intermediation — DG Afrique operates where exchange is built.

intro.title: A discreet, structured and continental operator
intro.text: DG Afrique is an international trade operator based in Abidjan and active in nine West African countries. We operate as a broker, raw materials supplier and commercial intermediary for complex cross-border transactions.

modes.title: Three ways to accelerate your operations
modes.brokerageText: Connecting stakeholders, qualifying opportunities and monitoring high-requirement transactions.
modes.supplyText: Structured access to raw materials, agricultural products, equipment and inputs.
modes.intermediationText: Commercial coordination between buyers, suppliers, investors and local partners.

countries.title: Active across key trade corridors
countries.intro: Our regional network supports exchanges between local markets and international partners.

about.title: An African company with a global vocation
about.vision: To become the benchmark operator for raw materials trade and international intermediation in West Africa.
about.mission: To facilitate commercial exchange between Africa and global partners with rigor, discretion and strong local grounding.
about.history: Founded in 2023 in Abidjan, DG Afrique positioned itself from the outset as a discreet yet structured player in international trade. Our strength is a network of strategic partners across several continents and deep knowledge of West African markets.
about.timeline2023Text: Created in Abidjan with a clear focus on cross-border operations.
about.timelineRegionalText: Structuring an active network across West Africa.
about.timelineContinentalText: Progressive development of commercial partnerships across several continents.
about.managerText: Management upholds seriousness, confidentiality and reliability in every operation undertaken.

activities.title: Six areas of intervention
activities.intro: DG Afrique operates in commercial transactions that require network, method and detailed market knowledge.
activities.minesText: Trading, transit and brokerage of minerals and metals across West Africa.
activities.importText: Facilitation of cross-border commercial exchange for goods and industrial products.
activities.agricultureText: Trade in agricultural products, foodstuffs and agro-industrial raw materials.
activities.constructionText: Supply of materials, equipment and services for construction projects.
activities.tradingText: Forex trading operations and international commercial support.
activities.financeText: Cross-border transfers and financing for commercial and trading operations.
activities.ctaText: Share your file with us so our team can assess possible avenues for collaboration.

presence.title: Present where Africa trades
presence.intro: DG Afrique operates from Abidjan with an active presence in eight other West African countries.
presence.expansionText: Our regional presence is designed to consolidate reliable corridors between suppliers, buyers and financial partners while preparing progressive expansion into other African markets.

partnership.title: Let us build together
partnership.intro: Are you an operator, supplier, buyer or investor? Send us your request. Each file is reviewed with seriousness and confidentiality.
partnership.success: Your request has been sent successfully. We will reply within 48 hours.
